name: Whisper-Hindi2Hinglish-Swift
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.073 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-01-07. Caveats: the card's own note says these WERs are scored against Hinglish (Latin-script) text generated by BOTH models, so the base's 104/106/110 figures are base-as-is against Latin-script references, not a fair same-target comparison for a Devanagari/Latin script choice; the gap is real but its size is mostly script mismatch. whisper-base is 74M, not a frontier base.
